unit.why: A single narrative: the death of the tsaddik's four-year-old grandson Berele, whom the late Maggid had told him to name after himself, and who was the Maggid's soul.

stories.start_quote: והנה בתוך שלשים לפטירת אשתו הרבנית
stories.end_quote: אבל גם עתה אין הדור ראוי לזה
stories.summary_en: Within thirty days of his wife's death, the tsaddik's four-year-old grandson Berele dies. The tsaddik reveals that at the circumcision the late Maggid of Mezeritch had come to him and told him to name the child Dov Ber, because the child carried the Maggid's soul. He weeps at the funeral and tells his son the death was a punishment for mourning his mother on Shabbat and holidays. He adds that the generation was again unworthy of such a soul.
